description: Environment setup and baseline verification. Install additional dependencies needed for the MVP (Supabase JS client, Vitest). Confirm existing build and typecheck pass. Fix any pre-existing issues.
steps: Add dependencies to package.json: @supabase/supabase-js (client-side and server-side Supabase access), vitest and @testing-library/react for testing
Run pnpm install to confirm all deps resolve
Run pnpm run typecheck to confirm zero TypeScript errors
Run pnpm run build to confirm static export succeeds
Add 'test' script to package.json pointing to vitest
Fix the eslint.config.mjs import issue (change 'eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals' to 'eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals.js') so build linting does not emit the ESLint warning
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run typecheck passes with zero errors
pnpm run build succeeds and produces out/ directory
vitest is in devDependencies with a test script in package.json
ESLint import warning for core-web-vitals is resolved
verification: pnpm run test -- --run (should exit cleanly even with no test files)
findings: eslint-config-next 15.5.2 exports legacy eslintrc-format objects (not flat config arrays), so spreading them directly fails. Fixed by using @eslint/eslintrc FlatCompat to bridge the legacy configs into flat config format. Also removed an invalid eslint-disable comment referencing non-existent rule 'react-hooks/set-state-in-effect' in providers.tsx. Added vitest.config.ts with passWithNoTests to allow test command to exit cleanly when no test files exist yet.
